diagnostics.message: the customer-spoken side of this alias carries the dietary-restriction marker "lactose". Canonicalization runs BEFORE the parse, so an alias on a safety-bearing phrase rewrites the customer's own words out of the utterance and the closed-taxonomy safety routing (§O#9: an unrecognized health/safety marker ESCALATES) never sees the marker it exists to catch. Forbidden by the ratified BKL-143 / BKL-123 / BKL-171 rulings; an allergen or dietary phrase must reach the parser intact.
